name: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression
label: Quest
description: Lar Prowltusk has found invasion plans in Kolkar Crag, west of Sen'jin Village. The Kolkar centaurs plan to strike Durotar's settlements and Orgrimmar.

clips.title: The story
paras: Lar Prowltusk has found invasion plans in Kolkar Crag, west of Sen'jin Village. The Kolkar centaurs plan to strike Durotar's settlements and Orgrimmar.

Lar Prowltusk, a troll tracker scouting western Durotar, slipped into Kolkar Crag under cover of night. There he found the Kolkar centaurs planning more than scattered coastal raids. Three centaur leaders had divided the invasion plans among them, with attacks aimed at the Valley of Trials, Sen'jin Village, and the gates of Orgrimmar.

You are sent into Kolkar Crag to destroy the three attack scrolls before the centaurs can strike. The dry canyons hold their camps, and each scroll belongs to a different leader. Lar Prowltusk believes the Horde would defeat a full invasion, but burning the plans can spare Durotar's defenders costly fighting while their young nation finds its footing.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lower your voice, adventurer. The Kolkar centaurs lie just over the ridge to the west in Kolkar Crag.
Last night while they were raiding, I snuck into their village and discovered that the dirty beasts have a three-tiered attack planned on the travelers and orcs of Durotar.
We mustn't let their invasion come to fruition. Perhaps you can muster the might needed to infiltrate Kolkar Crag and destroy their attack plans.
Last I saw, they had divided them up amongst three of their leaders.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The centaurs have proven to be a consistent nuisance to the Horde. Their intentions to lay siege to our homeland cannot be tolerated.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Horde would surely prevail if the Kolkar centaurs were to attack. But by preventing such an attack, we have spared our mighty warriors unnecessary bloodshed.
And as sure as there is sand in the Tanaris desert, we know that there will be blood spilled before these trying times are through.
You have served your people well, adventurer.
